race.title: All-Weather Championship Season 14 Has Begun Apprentice Handicap (Div 2)
race.verdict: GRESSINGTON holds a significant class edge over most here on the pick of his form and with his latest C&D effort easily overlooked, he could be worth siding with from a career-low mark starting out for a shrewd stable. Joud is easily one of the least exposed and is a threat, with Coulsty Exchange and Sovereign Class next best. GRESSINGTON (IRE) JOUD COULSTY EXCHANGE (IRE)
